text:
deploy-bot: beginning slice 2/10 of v2 rollout for api.redwood.com (deploy=rb-7255554321). watch 20m. ops watchers: @claire @theo. route split: /generate + /chat to v2 for unpinned tenants.
claire: taking lead. heads up: we have a cluster of tenants with older SDKs that omit X-Api-Version and rely on default routing. plan: identify and pre-pin any tenant with mobile_ratio > 0.35 AND sdk_version < 3.2.0.
theo: ran quick sim on EU traffic 1: saw intermittent 429 bursts from streaming-heavy tenants when routed to v2. not enough to fail slice but enough to justify pre-pins.
anika: can deploybot add metadata to pins so we know why they exist? also set expiry to avoid clutter.
deploy-bot: yes. use `deploybot pin-tenant --id <tenant> --route v1 --reason "legacy-sdk header missing" --expires 2026-04-09T10:00:00Z`.
yusuf: adding automated rule suggestion: match tenant.sdk_version < 3.2.0 AND traffic.streaming_pct > 0.3 -> candidate pin. will run matcher now.
deploy-bot: matcher found 4 tenants: t-720, t-731, t-742, t-753. ready to pin on @claire confirm.
claire: apply pins with 48h expiry. execute.
deploy-bot: pins applied: t-720 -> v1 (rb-7255554321-pin1), t-731 -> v1 (rb-7255554321-pin2), t-742 -> v1 (rb-7255554321-pin3), t-753 -> v1 (rb-7255554321-pin4).
theo: re-running smoke: EU p50 +9ms, v2 429 ratio down to baseline. looks stable for now. proceeding to start slice.
anika: rollback criteria posted here: sustained v2_error_rate >= 3% over 5m OR v2_429_ratio > 0.04 for 4m OR stream_reset_rate > 0.5% for 5m -> immediate rollback. latency circuit: p95 > 850ms for 3m -> auto-fallback. set pager to infra@oncall.
yusuf: release notes need a short callout: advise clients to set X-Api-Version: v2 to avoid ambiguity; also include retry guidance for 429s (exponential backoff + jitter). I'll PR the blurb to docs and link the SDK upgrade guide.
claire: adding a note to the quickstart: example curl `curl -H "X-Api-Version: v2" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.com/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'`.
deploy-bot: watch window active. will post status update at end of 20m or on trigger.
theo: collecting traffic snapshots for post-mortem in case we need to extend pins.
anika: leaving this thread as canonical for the pre-pin decision, expiry times, and rollback thresholds. will unpin after expiry unless extended. :lock:
claire: noted. pinging SDK on-call to watch for any client-side chatter.
deploy-bot: slice 2/10 complete: no automatic fallback triggered, moving to slice 3/10 in 10m. final status: stable.
